book_name: 恋练有词高考英语词汇上

words.tr:
auxv. 将会；愿意；
n. 意志；意愿；遗嘱；
words.ex: I will go to the park tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我明天会去公园。
words.en: The word 'will' can be used as a noun to refer to the faculty by which a person decides on and initiates action, or as a verb to indicate a desire or intention to do something.

words.tr: adj. 愿意的；乐意的； v. “will”的现在分词；
words.ex: He is willing to help his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他愿意帮助他的朋友。
words.en: If someone is willing to do something, they are happy to do it if it is needed.

words.ex: He willingly helped his friend with homework.
words.ex_cn: 他乐意帮助朋友做作业。
words.en: If you do something willingly, you do it because you want to do it, not because you have been forced to do it.

words.ex: His willingness to help made everyone happy.
words.ex_cn: 他乐于帮忙，让每个人都感到开心。
words.en: The quality or state of being prepared to do something; readiness.

words.tr: adj. 不愿意的；不情愿的；
words.ex: He was unwilling to help his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他不愿意帮助他的朋友。
words.en: If you are unwilling to do something, you do not want to do it and will not agree to do it.

words.ex: He walks from school to home.
words.ex_cn: 他从学校走回家。
words.en: Indicating the point in space at which a journey, motion, or action starts.

words.tr:
n. 前面；前线；
adj. 前面的；
words.ex: The front of the house has a big garden.
words.ex_cn: 房子的前面有一个大花园。
words.en: The front is the part of something that faces forward or is the most important or prominent part.

words.ex: The town is near the frontier of the country.
words.ex_cn: 这个小镇靠近国家的边境。
words.en: A frontier is a border between two countries or the area close to it. It can also refer to the limit of knowledge or the most advanced or recent stage in the development of something.

words.tr:
conj. 但是；然而；
prep. 除…以外；
adv. 只能；仅仅；
words.ex: I like apples, but I don't like oranges.
words.ex_cn: 我喜欢苹果，但是我不喜欢橙子。
words.en: used to introduce a phrase or clause contrasting with what has already been mentioned

words.tr: n. 屠夫；肉贩； adj. “butch”的比较级；
words.ex: The butcher sold fresh meat at the market.
words.ex_cn: 屠夫在市场卖新鲜的肉。
words.en: A butcher is a person who prepares and sells meat. As a verb, to butcher means to kill and prepare animals for meat, or to kill people in a cruel and unnecessary way.

words.ex: She spread butter on her toast.
words.ex_cn: 她在吐司上抹了黄油。
words.en: Butter is a pale yellow edible fatty substance made by churning cream and used as a spread or in cooking.

words.ex: A butterfly is flying over the flowers.
words.ex_cn: 一只蝴蝶在花上飞舞。
words.en: A butterfly is an insect with large, often brightly coloured wings.

words.ex: She sewed a button on her coat.
words.ex_cn: 她把一颗纽扣缝在了外套上。
words.en: A button is a small, usually round object that you press to operate a device or a machine, or a small, round object that you fasten to clothing to keep it closed.

words.ex: He is not happy.
words.ex_cn: 他不开心。
words.en: Used to make a negative statement or to negate a verb, adjective, or other adverb.

words.tr:
n. 笔记；便条；音调；注释；语气；
v. 注意；记录；
words.ex: I took notes during the lecture.
words.ex_cn: 我在讲座期间做了笔记。
words.en: A note is a short piece of writing, a musical sound, or a piece of paper money. It can also mean to pay attention to something or to write something down.

words.tr: adj. 值得注意的；显著的；著名的；
words.ex: This is a notable achievement.
words.ex_cn: 这是一个值得注意的成就。
words.en: Worthy of attention or notice; remarkable.

words.ex: She is a good student.
words.ex_cn: 她是一个好学生。
words.en: Something that is good is of a high quality, standard, or level.

words.ex: He believes in God.
words.ex_cn: 他相信上帝。
words.en: In monotheistic religions, God is the supreme being, creator, and principal object of faith.

words.tr:
n. 金；金币；金黄色；
adj. 金色的；
words.ex: He bought a gold ring for his wife.
words.ex_cn: 他为妻子买了一枚金戒指。
words.en: Gold is a valuable, yellow-colored metal that is used for making jewelry and as an international currency.

words.ex: The golden sun set behind the hills.
words.ex_cn: 金色的太阳在山后落下。
words.en: Something that is golden is bright yellow in color, like gold. It can also describe something that is very good or valuable.

words.ex: He feeds his goldfish every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上喂他的金鱼。
words.en: A goldfish is a small orange or golden-colored fish that is often kept as a pet in aquariums or ponds.

words.ex: He plays golf every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他每个周末都打高尔夫。
words.en: Golf is a game in which you use long sticks called clubs to hit a small hard ball into holes that are spread out over a large area of grassy land.

words.ex: The rain made the road wet.
words.ex_cn: 雨使得道路变湿了。
words.en: To create, produce, or prepare something, especially by putting parts together or by combining materials.

words.tr: v. 使得；制作；做；“make”的现在分词； n. 制造；
words.ex: The rain is making the road slippery.
words.ex_cn: 下雨使得道路变得滑。
words.en: The process of creating or producing something.

words.ex: He is a maker of wooden chairs.
words.ex_cn: 他是木椅的制造者。
words.en: A maker is a person or company that makes or produces something.

words.tr:
n. 时间；时期；次数；
v. 计时；安排时间；
words.ex: I don't have time to finish my homework.
words.ex_cn: 我没有时间完成作业。
words.en: Time is the ongoing sequence of existence and events that occurs in an apparently irreversible succession from the past, through the present, into the future.

words.tr: n. 时间表；时刻表；课程表；
words.ex: The school publishes a new timetable every term.
words.ex_cn: 学校每学期都会公布新的时间表。
words.en: A timetable is a detailed plan showing the times at which things are intended to happen, especially the times at which particular events or activities are planned to occur.

words.ex: He says hello every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上都说你好。
words.en: To express in words; to state or declare.

words.tr: v. “say”的现在分词；说； n. 谚语；警句；
words.ex: He is saying goodbye to his friends.
words.ex_cn: 他正在向朋友们道别。
words.en: A short, well-known expression that states a general truth or gives advice.

words.tr:
adj. 全部的；
adv. 全部地；
n. 全部；
words.ex: All the students passed the test.
words.ex_cn: 所有学生都通过了考试。
words.en: All is used to indicate that every part of something or every one of a group is included or involved.

words.tr: v. 允许；留出；给予；承认；
words.ex: My parents allow me to go out on weekends.
words.ex_cn: 我的父母允许我周末外出。
words.en: If someone is allowed to do something, it is all right for them to do it and they will not get into trouble.

words.tr: phrase. 考虑到；体谅；允许有；留出
words.ex: The plan allows for extra time if needed.
words.ex_cn: 这个计划为需要时留出了额外的时间。
words.en: To make provision or plans for something; to take into consideration.

words.ex: France was an ally of the United States in the war.
words.ex_cn: 法国在战争中是美国的同盟者。
words.en: An ally is a country, organization, or person that helps and supports another country, organization, or person in a difficult situation.

words.ex: The teacher will allocate books to students.
words.ex_cn: 老师将给学生分配书籍。
words.en: To allocate something means to give it to a particular person or use it for a particular purpose.

words.ex: He is allergic to peanuts.
words.ex_cn: 他对花生过敏。
words.en: If you are allergic to something, you become ill or get a rash when you eat it, smell it, or touch it.

words.ex: My parents give me a weekly allowance.
words.ex_cn: 我父母每周给我零用钱。
words.en: An allowance is money that is given regularly, usually to a child, by their parents, or by the government to someone who is unemployed or ill.

words.ex: He was born in the year 2000.
words.ex_cn: 他出生于2000年。
words.en: A year is a period of time that is approximately equal to the time it takes for the Earth to make one complete orbit around the Sun.

words.tr:
adj. 每年的；
adv. 每年地；
words.ex: He pays his rent yearly.
words.ex_cn: 他每年支付一次房租。
words.en: Happening or done once a year or every year.

words.tr:
n. 工作；活计；作品；制作品；
v. （使）工作；（使）运转；操作；经营；起作用；
words.ex: He finds his work very meaningful.
words.ex_cn: 他觉得他的工作很有意义。
words.en: Work is an activity in which you use effort in order to do a task or achieve a result.

words.ex: The worker fixed the machine quickly.
words.ex_cn: 这位工作者迅速修好了机器。
words.en: A worker is a person who does a particular job to earn money.

words.tr: v. 工作；劳动；“work”的现在分词； adj. 工作的；劳动的；
words.ex: He is working in a factory.
words.ex_cn: 他正在工厂工作。
words.en: Engaged in work, especially as one's regular occupation; functioning or able to function.

words.ex: He works hard during his workday.
words.ex_cn: 他在工作日努力工作。
words.en: A workday is a day on which people go to work.

words.tr: n. 劳动力；工人总数；职工总数；
words.ex: The factory needs a larger workforce to meet demand.
words.ex_cn: 工厂需要更多的劳动力来满足需求。
words.en: The workforce is the total number of people who are employed by a particular company or who are available to work in a particular country or area.

words.ex: His workload is too heavy this week.
words.ex_cn: 他这周的工作量太大了。
words.en: The amount of work to be done by someone, especially in a particular period of time.

words.ex: My workmate brought coffee to the office.
words.ex_cn: 我的同事给办公室带了咖啡。
words.en: A workmate is someone you work with.

words.tr: n. 工作场所；工作地点；
words.ex: The new safety rules apply to the workplace.
words.ex_cn: 新的安全规则适用于工作场所。
words.en: A workplace is a place where people work, such as an office or factory.

words.ex: We attended a workshop on writing skills.
words.ex_cn: 我们参加了一个关于写作技巧的研讨会。
words.en: A workshop is a room or building where things are made or repaired using tools or machinery. It can also refer to a meeting at which a group of people engage in intensive discussion and activity on a particular subject or project.

words.tr:
v. 使用；利用；
n. 使用；用途；
words.ex: I use a pen to write.
words.ex_cn: 我用笔写字。
words.en: If you use something, you do something with it in order to do a job or to achieve a particular result or effect.

words.tr:
v. 滥用；误用；虐待
n. 滥用；误用；虐待
words.ex: He misuses his phone during class.
words.ex_cn: 他在上课时滥用手机。
words.en: The incorrect or improper use of something.

words.ex: We can reuse plastic bottles to reduce waste.
words.ex_cn: 我们可以再使用塑料瓶来减少浪费。
words.en: To use something again after it has been used once.

words.tr: phrase. v. 逐渐接受（某种观点或想法）；改变看法；最终同意
words.ex: He didn't like coffee at first, but he came round to it after a few tries.
words.ex_cn: 他一开始不喜欢咖啡，但试了几次后就接受了。
words.en: If you come round to an idea, you eventually change your mind and accept it or agree with it.

words.ex: The usage of this machine is very simple.
words.ex_cn: 这个机器的使用非常简单。
words.en: The way in which something is used or the fact of being used.

words.ex: This tool is useful for solving math problems.
words.ex_cn: 这个工具对解决数学问题很有用。
words.en: If something is useful, you can use it to do something or to help you in some way.

words.ex: This broken phone is useless.
words.ex_cn: 这部坏掉的手机毫无用处。
words.en: If something is useless, it is not able to do what it is supposed to do or is not effective.

words.ex: The app has many daily users.
words.ex_cn: 这个应用有很多日常用户。
words.en: A person who uses a product, service, or system, especially in a digital or technological context.

words.ex: The fish swam fast using its fin.
words.ex_cn: 鱼用它的鳍快速游动。
words.en: A fin is a thin flat part that sticks out from the body of a fish, used for swimming and balancing.

words.tr: v. 发现；找到；建立；认为；“find”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He found a strange stone on the beach.
words.ex_cn: 他在海滩上发现了一块奇怪的石头。
words.en: To establish or set up (an organization, institution, or place) on a firm or permanent basis.

words.tr: n. 调查发现； v. 找到；发现；“find”的现在分词；
words.ex: The finding of the study surprised many scientists.
words.ex_cn: 这项研究的调查发现让许多科学家感到惊讶。
words.en: A finding is a discovery or conclusion reached as a result of an investigation or research.

words.tr:
adj. 很好的；晴朗的；健康的；
n. 罚款；
words.ex: She did a fine job on the project.
words.ex_cn: 她在这个项目上做得很好。
words.en: If you say that something is fine, you mean that it is satisfactory or acceptable.

words.ex: He hurt his finger while cooking.
words.ex_cn: 他在做饭时弄伤了手指。
words.en: One of the five long parts at the end of your hand, including your thumb.

words.tr:
n. 指纹；指印
v. 采指纹
words.ex: The police found his fingerprint on the glass.
words.ex_cn: 警察在玻璃上找到了他的指纹。
words.en: A fingerprint is a mark made by the pattern of ridges on the pad of a human finger, used for identification purposes.

words.ex: He will finish his homework before dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他会在晚饭前完成作业。
words.en: To finish something means to reach the end of it or to complete it.

words.ex: He bought a new bike yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 他昨天买了一辆新自行车。
words.en: Recently made, invented, introduced, or discovered; not existing before.

words.ex: He was newly hired as a teacher.
words.ex_cn: 他最近被聘为老师。
words.en: Newly means something that has happened or been done recently.

words.ex: He is taller than his brother.
words.ex_cn: 他比他弟弟高。
words.en: used to introduce the second element in a comparison

words.ex: The child is playing with toys.
words.ex_cn: 这个儿童正在玩玩具。
words.en: A child is a human being who is not yet an adult.

words.ex: His childish laugh made everyone smile.
words.ex_cn: 他孩子气的笑声让每个人都笑了。
words.en: If you describe someone, especially an adult, as childish, you disapprove of them because they behave in an immature way.

words.ex: He remembers his childhood as a happy time.
words.ex_cn: 他记得自己的童年是一段快乐的时光。
words.en: Childhood is the period of a person's life when they are a child.

words.tr:
n. 寒冷；寒意；
v. 变冷；使冰冷；
words.ex: The chill of the morning made me wear a jacket.
words.ex_cn: 早晨的寒冷让我穿上了夹克。
words.en: A chill is a feeling of coldness, often accompanied by shivering. It can also refer to a feeling of fear or anxiety. As a verb, to chill means to make something cold, or to relax and take it easy.

words.tr: adj. 寒冷的；冷淡的；冷漠的；
words.ex: The morning air was chilly.
words.ex_cn: 早晨的空气很寒冷。
words.en: Something that is chilly is unpleasantly cold.

words.ex: My birthday is in May.
words.ex_cn: 我的生日在五月。
words.en: May is the fifth month of the Gregorian calendar, following April and preceding June.

words.ex: Maybe it will rain tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 也许明天会下雨。
words.en: used to show that something is possible or that something might be true

words.tr:
n. 男人；人；
v. 操作；
words.ex: The man is walking his dog in the park.
words.ex_cn: 那个男人正在公园里遛狗。
words.en: A man is an adult human male.

words.tr: adj. 有男子气概的；阳刚的；
words.ex: He showed manly courage during the crisis.
words.ex_cn: 他在危机中表现出了男子气概。
words.en: If you describe a man's behaviour or appearance as manly, you mean that it has qualities which are considered typical of a man, such as strength or courage.

words.ex: I will see you tomorrow day.
words.ex_cn: 我明天见你。
words.en: A day is a period of twenty-four hours, especially from twelve o'clock one night to twelve o'clock the next night.

words.tr:
adj. 每天的；每日的；
adv. 每天；每日；
n. 日报；
words.ex: He drinks water daily.
words.ex_cn: 他每天喝水。
words.en: Something that happens or is done daily happens or is done every day.

words.ex: The birds sing at daylight.
words.ex_cn: 鸟儿在日光下歌唱。
words.en: Daylight is the natural light that comes from the sun during the day.

words.ex: He had a daydream about winning the lottery.
words.ex_cn: 他做了一个中彩票的白日梦。
words.en: A daydream is a series of pleasant thoughts about something you would like to happen, often about something that is unlikely to happen.

words.ex: He is a daydreamer who sits by the window.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个坐在窗边做白日梦的人。
words.en: A person who indulges in daydreams; someone who is often lost in their own thoughts or fantasies.

words.ex: I know the answer.
words.ex_cn: 我知道答案。
words.en: To have information in your mind as a result of experience or because you have learned or been told it.

words.tr:
adj. 未知的；不为人知的；
n. 未知的地方（或事物）；
words.ex: The unknown cause of the accident is being investigated.
words.ex_cn: 事故的未知原因正在调查中。
words.en: If something is unknown, it is not known or recognized by people.

words.tr: n. 知识；了解；学问；学识；
words.ex: He gained knowledge from reading books.
words.ex_cn: 他通过读书获得了知识。
words.en: Knowledge is information and understanding about a subject which a person has, or which all people have.

words.ex: He runs like a cheetah.
words.ex_cn: 他跑得像猎豹一样。
words.en: To find something enjoyable or agreeable; to have a positive feeling towards someone or something.

words.ex: He dislikes eating broccoli.
words.ex_cn: 他不喜欢吃西兰花。
words.en: If you dislike someone or something, you consider them to be unpleasant and do not like them.

words.ex: Unlike his brother, he likes quiet places.
words.ex_cn: 不像他的兄弟，他喜欢安静的地方。
words.en: If one thing is unlike another thing, the two things are different in nature or in appearance.

words.ex: He is likely to win the game.
words.ex_cn: 他很可能赢得比赛。
words.en: If something is likely, it will probably happen or is expected.

words.ex: It is unlikely to rain tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 明天不大可能下雨。
words.en: If you say that something is unlikely to happen or unlikely to be true, you mean that you think it will not happen or that it is not true, although it is not certain.

words.ex: There is a high likelihood of rain tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 明天很大可能会下雨。
words.en: The likelihood of something happening is how likely it is to happen.

words.ex: I like coffee, and she likes it likewise.
words.ex_cn: 我喜欢咖啡，她也喜欢。
words.en: You use likewise when you are comparing two methods, states, or situations and saying that they are similar.

words.ex: I think it is a good idea.
words.ex_cn: 我认为这是个好主意。
words.en: To have a particular opinion, belief, or idea about someone or something.

words.ex: He is a deep thinker who solves problems slowly.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个深思熟虑的思考者，慢慢解决问题。
words.en: A thinker is someone who spends a lot of time thinking deeply about important things, especially someone who is famous for thinking of new or interesting ideas.

words.tr: v. 重新思考；重新考虑；
words.ex: We need to rethink our plan.
words.ex_cn: 我们需要重新思考我们的计划。
words.en: To consider again, especially with a view to changing or altering.

words.tr:
v. 帮助；
n. 帮助；
words.ex: He helps his sister with her homework.
words.ex_cn: 他帮助妹妹做作业。
words.en: If you help someone, you make it easier for them to do something, for example by doing part of the work for them or by giving them advice or information.

words.ex: The child felt helpless when he lost his mother.
words.ex_cn: 当孩子失去妈妈时，他感到无助。
words.en: Unable to defend oneself or to act without help.

words.ex: He is a helper for his little sister.
words.ex_cn: 他是他妹妹的帮手。
words.en: A helper is a person who helps someone else.

words.ex: This book is helpful for learning English.
words.ex_cn: 这本书对学习英语有帮助。
words.en: If you describe someone as helpful, you mean that they help you in some way, such as doing part of your job for you or by giving you advice or information.

words.ex: She enjoys simple life in the countryside.
words.ex_cn: 她喜欢乡村里的简单生活。
words.en: Life is the existence of an individual human being or animal.

words.ex: The lifeguard saved a boy from drowning.
words.ex_cn: 救生员救了一个差点溺水的男孩。
words.en: A lifeguard is a person who is responsible for the safety of people at a beach or swimming pool, and who rescues those who are in danger of drowning.

words.ex: He lives a 24/7 lifestyle, working and texting all day and night.
words.ex_cn: 他过着24/7的生活方式，整天整夜地工作和发信息。
words.en: The way in which a person lives is their lifestyle.

words.ex: He spent his lifetime teaching children.
words.ex_cn: 他一生都在教孩子们。
words.en: The period of time during which an individual is alive.

words.tr:
v. 举起；提起；抬起；
n. 电梯；搭便车；
words.ex: He lift the box with both hands.
words.ex_cn: 他用双手举起箱子。
words.en: To lift something means to move it to a higher position. A lift is a device that carries people or goods up and down inside buildings.

words.ex: Please come to my house tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 请明天来我家。
words.en: To move or travel towards the speaker or with the speaker; to arrive at a place; to happen or take place.

words.ex: He likes to watch comedy on TV.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在电视上看喜剧。
words.en: A comedy is a type of drama or other art form the main object of which, according to modern notions, is to amuse.

words.ex: This chair is very comfortable.
words.ex_cn: 这把椅子非常舒适。
words.en: If a piece of furniture or an item of clothing is comfortable, it makes you feel physically relaxed when you use it or wear it, for example because it is soft.

words.ex: The soft chair gives me comfort.
words.ex_cn: 这把软椅子给我带来舒服。
words.en: If you comfort someone, you make them feel less worried, unhappy, or upset, for example by saying kind things to them.

words.tr: adj. 使人不舒服的；不自在的；
words.ex: The chair is uncomfortable to sit on.
words.ex_cn: 这把椅子坐起来让人不舒服。
words.en: If you are uncomfortable, you are slightly worried or embarrassed, and not relaxed and confident.

words.ex: My brother goes to school every morning.
words.ex_cn: 我弟弟每天早上上学。
words.en: A school is an institution where children are educated.

words.ex: The preschooler plays with blocks every morning.
words.ex_cn: 这个学龄前儿童每天早上都玩积木。
words.en: A preschooler is a child who is old enough to go to preschool but has not yet started school.

words.ex: He carries his schoolbag to school every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天背着书包去学校。
words.en: A bag used by a student to carry books and other school supplies.

words.tr: n. 教科书; adj. （美）教科书式的；过于简单的
words.ex: He opened his schoolbook to do his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他打开课本做作业。
words.en: A schoolbook is a book used as a standard work for the study of a particular subject in a school.

words.ex: The schoolboy solved the math problem quickly.
words.ex_cn: 那个小学生很快解出了这道数学题。
words.en: A schoolboy is a boy who attends school.

words.ex: The schoolgirl walks to school every morning.
words.ex_cn: 那个女学生每天早上步行去学校。
words.en: A schoolgirl is a girl who attends school.

words.ex: I met my schoolmate at the park yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 我昨天在公园遇到了我的同学。
words.en: A schoolmate is someone who goes to or went to the same school as you.

words.tr:
prep. 在…之后；
adv. 以后；后来；
words.ex: I will call you after dinner.
words.ex_cn: 我晚饭后给你打电话。
words.en: In addition to its use as a preposition meaning 'behind in place or time,' 'after' can also function as an adverb to indicate a subsequent time or event.

words.ex: We have lunch in the afternoon.
words.ex_cn: 我们在下午吃午饭。
words.en: The part of the day from noon or lunchtime to evening.

words.ex: We had dinner, and afterwards we went for a walk.
words.ex_cn: 我们吃了晚饭，后来去散步了。
words.en: If you do something or if something happens afterwards, you do it or it happens after a particular event or time that has already been mentioned.

words.tr:
v. 需要；
n. 需要；
words.ex: I need help with my homework.
words.ex_cn: 我需要帮助做作业。
words.en: If you need something, you must have it because it is essential.

words.ex: The needy family received food from the charity.
words.ex_cn: 这个贫穷的家庭从慈善机构收到了食物。
words.en: Needy people do not have enough food, medicine, or clothing, or adequate houses.

words.ex: He bought a new phone, but it was needless.
words.ex_cn: 他买了一部新手机，但这是不必要的。
words.en: If you describe something as needless, you mean that it is unnecessary and often harmful or undesirable.

words.ex: I shall go to the park tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我明天要去公园。
words.en: used to indicate future action or intention, or to express obligation or necessity

words.tr: adv. 仅仅；就；只是；刚刚；恰好；
words.ex: He just wants to sleep.
words.ex_cn: 他仅仅想睡觉。
words.en: Used to indicate that something is exactly the case or is happening at this moment.

words.ex: The judge made a fair decision to show justice.
words.ex_cn: 法官做出了公正的裁决以体现公正。
words.en: Justice is fairness in the way that people are treated.

words.tr: n. 非正义；不公平；不公正
words.ex: He cried out against the injustice.
words.ex_cn: 他抗议这种不公。
words.en: Injustice refers to the lack of fairness or justice in a situation or action.

words.ex: He tried to justify his mistake by saying he was tired.
words.ex_cn: 他试图以自己累了为由来证明自己的错误是正当的。
words.en: To justify something means to show or prove that it is reasonable, necessary, or correct.

words.ex: I read a book every night.
words.ex_cn: 我每天晚上读书。
words.en: To look at and comprehend the meaning of written or printed matter by interpreting the characters or symbols of which it is composed.

words.ex: The reader enjoyed the novel very much.
words.ex_cn: 这位读者非常喜欢这本小说。
words.en: A person who reads or who is fond of reading.

words.tr: n. 阅读；读物； v. 读；“read”的现在分词；
words.ex: Reading is an important skill for students.
words.ex_cn: 阅读是学生的重要技能。
words.en: The action or skill of reading written or printed matter silently or aloud.

words.ex: He reread the book to understand it better.
words.ex_cn: 他重新读了这本书，以便更好地理解。
words.en: To read (something) again.

words.tr:
n. 家；家庭；
adv. 在家；
adj. 家的；家庭的；
words.ex: I love to go home after work.
words.ex_cn: 我下班后喜欢回家。
words.en: The place where one lives permanently, especially as a member of a family or household.

words.ex: The homeless man slept on the bench.
words.ex_cn: 那个无家可归的人睡在长椅上。
words.en: If someone is homeless, they have no permanent place to live.

words.ex: He returned to his homeland after many years.
words.ex_cn: 多年后，他回到了祖国。
words.en: Your homeland is your native country.

words.ex: The homeowner fixed the roof himself.
words.ex_cn: 房主自己修了屋顶。
words.en: A homeowner is a person who owns the house or apartment they live in.

words.ex: He felt homesick after moving to a new city.
words.ex_cn: 他搬到新城市后感到想家。
words.en: If you are homesick, you feel unhappy because you are away from home and are missing your family, friends, and home very much.

words.ex: He returned to his hometown after graduation.
words.ex_cn: 他毕业后回到了家乡。
words.en: Your hometown is the town or city where you were born or grew up.

words.ex: He finished his homework before dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他晚饭前完成了家庭作业。
words.en: Homework is school work that teachers give to pupils to do at home in the evening or at the weekend.

words.ex: He really loves his job.
words.ex_cn: 他真正地热爱他的工作。
words.en: You use really to emphasize that something is true or that it is the case.

words.tr: n. 感觉； v. 感到；“feel”的现在分词；
words.ex: I have a feeling it will rain tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我感觉明天会下雨。
words.en: An emotion or a physical sensation.

words.tr:
n. 书；账簿；
v. 预订；
words.ex: I read a book before sleep.
words.ex_cn: 我睡觉前读了一本书。
words.en: A book is a number of pieces of paper, usually with words printed on them, which are fastened together and fixed inside a cover of stronger paper or cardboard. Books contain information, stories, or poetry, for example.

words.tr: 短语动词. 有太多选择以至于难以决定；选择太多而令人眼花缭乱
words.ex: At the grocery store, I am spoiled for choice with so many types of apples.
words.ex_cn: 在杂货店，有这么多种类的苹果，我都不知道选哪个了。
words.en: To have so many good options that it is difficult to choose.

words.tr: n. （旅馆车票，戏票等的）登记人；寻选模特儿的人; n. （Booker）人名；（英）布克
words.ex: He is a booker at a theater.
words.ex_cn: 他在一家剧院做订票员。
words.en: A booker is someone whose job is to arrange bookings for events, performances, or appointments.

words.tr: n. 预订； v. 预订；“book”的现在分词；
words.ex: I made a booking for a hotel room.
words.ex_cn: 我预订了一间酒店房间。
words.en: The act of reserving accommodations, travel arrangements, tickets, etc., in advance.

words.ex: He read the booklet about the new rules.
words.ex_cn: 他读了那本关于新规则的小册子。
words.en: A booklet is a small, thin book that has a paper cover and that gives you information about something.

words.ex: The bookcase is full of storybooks.
words.ex_cn: 书架上放满了故事书。
words.en: A piece of furniture with shelves for storing books.

words.ex: He placed the bookend on both sides of the shelf.
words.ex_cn: 他把书挡放在书架的两侧。
words.en: A bookend is an object that is used to hold a row of books upright on a shelf.

words.ex: The bookseller recommended several new releases.
words.ex_cn: 书商推荐了几本新书。
words.en: A bookseller is a person or company that sells books.

words.ex: He put his books on the bookshelf.
words.ex_cn: 他把书放在书架上。
words.en: A piece of furniture with shelves for storing books.

words.ex: He bought a novel at the bookstore.
words.ex_cn: 他在书店买了一本小说。
words.en: A bookstore is a shop where books are sold.

words.ex: He buys a novel at the bookshop.
words.ex_cn: 他在书店买了一本小说。
words.en: A shop where books are sold.

words.ex: The dog follows its owner every day.
words.ex_cn: 狗每天跟随它的主人。
words.en: To go or come after (a person or thing proceeding ahead); move or travel behind.

words.tr: n. 追随者；拥护者；信徒；
words.ex: He is a loyal follower of the artist.
words.ex_cn: 他是这位艺术家的忠实追随者。
words.en: A follower is a person who supports and admires a particular person or set of ideas.

words.tr:
adj. 每个的；各自的；
pron. 每个；各自；
words.ex: Each student has a book.
words.ex_cn: 每个学生都有一本书。
words.en: Used to refer to every one of a group or series considered individually.

words.ex: The children are eager to open their presents.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们渴望打开他们的礼物。
words.en: If you are eager to do or have something, you want to do or have it very much.

words.ex: The eagle flies high above the mountains.
words.ex_cn: 鹰在山上面高飞。
words.en: A large bird of prey with a massive hooked bill and long broad wings, known for its keen sight and powerful soaring flight.

words.tr:
adv. 甚至；甚至于；
adj. 平坦的；
words.ex: He didn't even say goodbye.
words.ex_cn: 他甚至连再见都没说。
words.en: Even is used to emphasize something that is surprising or unlikely. It can also describe something that is flat, smooth, or level, or something that is equal in amount, degree, or value.

words.ex: The paint was applied unevenly on the wall.
words.ex_cn: 油漆在墙上涂得不均匀。
words.en: In a way that is not level, smooth, or regular.

words.tr: n. 一个特殊日子的前夕或前夜
words.ex: The eve of Christmas is very special.
words.ex_cn: 圣诞节前夜非常特别。
words.en: The period of time immediately before an event or occasion, especially the day before a holiday or festival.

words.ex: We have dinner together in the evening.
words.ex_cn: 我们在晚上一起吃晚饭。
words.en: The period of time at the end of the day, usually from about 6 p.m. to bedtime.

words.tr: n. 事件；大事；比赛项目；
words.ex: The school event was fun for everyone.
words.ex_cn: 学校的活动对每个人都很有趣。
words.en: An event is something that happens, especially when it is unusual or important.

words.ex: He waited for hours, and eventually got his turn.
words.ex_cn: 他等了几个小时，终于轮到他了。
words.en: At an unspecified later time; in the end.

words.ex: He told me the news.
words.ex_cn: 他告诉了我这个消息。
words.en: If you tell someone something, you give them information.

words.tr: n. 讲述者；（银行）出纳员；
words.ex: The old man is the teller of fairy tales.
words.ex_cn: 这位老人是童话故事的讲述者。
words.en: A teller is a person who works in a bank and whose job includes receiving and paying out money.

words.ex: He writes a letter every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天写一封信。
words.en: To write means to form letters, words, or symbols on a surface in order to communicate.

words.ex: He is a writer who loves to write stories.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位喜欢写故事的作家。
words.en: A writer is a person who writes books, stories, or articles as a job or regular occupation.

words.tr: n. 写作；文章； v. 写作；“write”的现在分词；
words.ex: His writing is clear and simple.
words.ex_cn: 他的写作清晰简洁。
words.en: The activity or skill of marking coherent words on paper and composing text.

words.ex: He had to rewrite his essay after the teacher gave feedback.
words.ex_cn: 他在老师给出反馈后不得不重写他的作文。
words.en: If someone rewrites a piece of writing such as a book, an article, or a law, they write it in a different way in order to improve it or because circumstances have changed.

words.tr:
n. 变化；变革；
v. 变化；变革；
words.ex: There was a big change in the weather.
words.ex_cn: 天气发生了很大的变化。
words.en: To make or become different; to alter or modify; to exchange or replace something with another.

words.tr: n. 转换开关装置；改变者
words.ex: He uses a coin changer at the parking lot.
words.ex_cn: 他在停车场使用硬币兑换机。
words.en: A changer is someone or something that changes or is used to change something.

words.ex: The weather is changeable in spring.
words.ex_cn: 春天的天气是多变的。
words.en: If something is changeable, it can be changed or it changes often.

words.ex: There is a chance it will rain tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 明天可能会下雨。
words.en: A chance is a possibility of something happening, often something that you want to happen.

words.tr:
n. 海峡；渠道；河床；频道；
v. 引导；
words.ex: The English Channel separates England from France.
words.ex_cn: 英吉利海峡将英格兰与法国分隔开。
words.en: A channel is a television station and the programs that it broadcasts. A channel is also a method or system that people use to send information, goods, etc. to each other.

words.tr:
n. 圣歌；赞美诗；喊叫
v. 吟唱；诵扬；反复叫喊
words.ex: The monks sang a traditional chant during the morning prayer.
words.ex_cn: 修道士们在晨祷时唱了一首传统圣歌。
words.en: A chant is a word or group of words that is repeated over and over again. It can also refer to a simple song, especially one that is sung in a religious service.

words.tr:
adj. 长时间的；长的；
adv. 始终；长久地；
n. 长期；长时间；
v. 盼望；渴望；
words.ex: We had a long meeting yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 我们昨天开了一个长时间的会议。
words.en: Having a great distance from one end to the other; extending over a large area.

words.tr:
n. 渴望；热望
adj. 渴望的；热望的
v. 渴望；热望；“long”的现在分词
v. 用练马绳训练马的各种步态
words.ex: Her longing for home grew stronger each day.
words.ex_cn: 她对家的渴望与日俱增。
words.en: A strong feeling of wanting something or someone.

words.tr: n. 通过；通道；段落；短文；
words.ex: The passage of the train through the tunnel was quick.
words.ex_cn: 火车通过隧道的速度很快。
words.en: A passage is a long narrow space with walls or fences on both sides, which connects one place or room with another.

words.tr:
n. 家庭；家族；
adj. 家庭的；家族的；
words.ex: He belongs to the 587 family.
words.ex_cn: 他属于587家族。
words.en: A family is a group of people who are related to each other, especially parents and their children.

words.ex: He became famous for his music and gained great fame.
words.ex_cn: 他因音乐而闻名，获得了巨大的名声。
words.en: the state of being known or talked about by many people, especially on account of notable achievements

words.ex: I am familiar with this song.
words.ex_cn: 我熟悉这首歌。
words.en: If someone or something is familiar to you, you recognize them or know them well.

words.ex: He is a famous singer.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位著名的歌手。
words.en: Known about by many people.

words.tr:
v. 离开；离去；留下；
n. 休假；
words.ex: He will leave the room after class.
words.ex_cn: 他下课后会离开房间。
words.en: To go away from a place or a person.

words.ex: He loves the world and wants to travel everywhere.
words.ex_cn: 他热爱这个世界，想要去所有地方旅行。
words.en: The earth, together with all of its countries, peoples, and natural features.

words.tr:
adv. 全球性地；
adj. 全球性的；
words.ex: The news spread worldwide overnight.
words.ex_cn: 这则新闻一夜之间传遍全球。
words.en: Something that is worldwide exists or happens in all parts of the world.

words.tr:
prep. 遍于…之上；越过；
adv. 大于；结束；越过；
words.ex: The blanket is over the bed.
words.ex_cn: 毯子盖在床上面。
words.en: In addition to the meanings related to physical position or movement above something, 'over' can also indicate completion, excess, or repetition.

words.tr:
n. 地方；方位；
v. 安放；安置；
words.ex: This is a quiet place to read books.
words.ex_cn: 这是一个安静的地方读书。
words.en: A particular position or point in space.

words.tr:
v. 生活；居住；活着；
adj. 活的；现场的；实况转播的；
words.ex: They live in a small house near the park.
words.ex_cn: 他们住在公园附近的一所小房子里。
words.en: To live means to be alive, to have your home in a particular place, or to spend your life in a particular way.

words.tr: adj. 充满生机的；活泼的；
words.ex: The market is lively with people and music.
words.ex_cn: 市场里人来人往，音乐欢快，充满生机。
words.en: If you describe someone as lively, you mean they are full of life, energy, or enthusiasm.

words.ex: The farmer feeds his livestock every morning.
words.ex_cn: 农夫每天早上喂他的家畜。
words.en: Livestock are animals such as cattle and sheep which are kept on a farm.

words.ex: He asks me a question every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天问我一个问题。
words.en: If you ask someone something, you say something to them in the form of a question because you want to know the answer.

words.ex: He asks for help when he is stuck.
words.ex_cn: 当他遇到困难时，他会寻求帮助。
words.en: To request something; to express a desire for something.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 问候，向……问好；打听，询问（某人的近况）
words.ex: My grandmother always asks after my health when we talk.
words.ex_cn: 我们谈话时，我奶奶总是问我的健康情况。
words.en: If you ask after someone, you ask for news about them, especially about their health.

words.ex: The baby is asleep in the crib.
words.ex_cn: 婴儿在婴儿床里睡着了。
words.en: If someone is asleep, they are sleeping.

words.ex: One aspect of learning English is practicing speaking.
words.ex_cn: 学习英语的一个方面是练习口语。
words.en: An aspect of something is one of the parts of its character or nature.

words.ex: I am eating now.
words.ex_cn: 我现在正在吃饭。
words.en: at the present time or moment

words.ex: Nowadays, many children use tablets to learn.
words.ex_cn: 现在，许多孩子用平板电脑学习。
words.en: At the present time, in contrast with the past.

words.ex: I like apples, and I also like oranges.
words.ex_cn: 我喜欢苹果，我也喜欢橙子。
words.en: You use also to give more information about something or to add another relevant fact.

words.ex: He is learning the English alphabet.
words.ex_cn: 他正在学习英文字母。
words.en: An alphabet is a set of letters or symbols in a fixed order used for writing a language.

words.ex: He has already finished his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他已经完成了他的作业。
words.en: You use already to say that something has happened, or that something had happened before the moment you are referring to.

words.ex: He eats healthy food every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天吃健康的食物。
words.en: Food is what people and animals eat to live and grow.

words.tr:
n. 傻瓜；蠢人；
v. 愚弄；
words.ex: He is a fool for spending all his money on games.
words.ex_cn: 他是个傻瓜，把所有钱都花在游戏上了。
words.en: A fool is someone who behaves in a silly way without thinking or someone who is tricked into believing or doing something that is not sensible.

words.ex: It was foolish to walk on the ice.
words.ex_cn: 在冰上走是愚蠢的。
words.en: If you say that someone or something is foolish, you mean that they are not sensible or show a lack of good judgment.

words.ex: He hurt his foot while playing soccer.
words.ex_cn: 他在踢足球时伤了脚。
words.en: The lower extremity of the leg below the ankle, on which a person stands or walks.

words.ex: He plays football with his friends every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他每周末和朋友踢足球。
words.en: A game played by two teams of eleven players with a round ball that may not be touched with the hands or arms during play except by the goalkeepers. The object of the game is to score goals by kicking or heading the ball into the opponents' goal.

words.tr:
n. 脚注；次要者
v. 为…作脚注
words.ex: He added a footnote to explain the word.
words.ex_cn: 他加了一个脚注来解释这个词。
words.en: A footnote is a note at the bottom of a page in a book which provides more detailed information about something mentioned in the text above it.

words.ex: The bear left a footprint in the snow.
words.ex_cn: 熊在雪地上留下了足迹。
words.en: A footprint is a mark made by a foot or shoe on a surface.

words.ex: He heard a footstep behind him.
words.ex_cn: 他听到身后有脚步声。
words.en: A footstep is the sound or mark that is made by someone walking each time their foot touches the ground.

words.ex: She keeps the room clean every day.
words.ex_cn: 她每天保持房间干净。
words.en: To continue to have or hold something; to maintain a condition or position.

words.ex: The zoo keeper feeds the lions every morning.
words.ex_cn: 动物园饲养员每天早上喂狮子。
words.en: A keeper is someone whose job is to look after a particular place or thing.

words.ex: The caterpillar becomes a butterfly.
words.ex_cn: 毛毛虫变成蝴蝶。
words.en: To begin to be something or to develop into something.

words.tr:
v. 展示；表明；给...看；
n. 节目；演出；展览会；表现；
words.ex: He shows his photos to his friends.
words.ex_cn: 他向朋友们展示他的照片。
words.en: To show something means to make it visible or to allow it to be seen. It can also refer to a performance or exhibition intended to entertain or educate.

words.ex: He is the author of this book.
words.ex_cn: 他是这本书的作者。
words.en: An author is a person who writes books, stories, or articles, especially as a job.

words.tr: n. 权威；官方机构；权力；权威人士；当局；
words.ex: The teacher is an authority on ancient history.
words.ex_cn: 这位老师是古代史方面的权威。
words.en: The power to make decisions or enforce rules.

words.tr: v. 证明…是真实的；鉴别
words.ex: He must authenticate his identity with a password.
words.ex_cn: 他必须用密码验证自己的身份。
words.en: To authenticate something means to prove or confirm that it is genuine or true.

words.tr:
adj. 最后的；最近的；
v. 持续；
adv. 最后；最近一次；
words.ex: This is the last chance to pass the exam.
words.ex_cn: 这是通过考试的最后机会。
words.en: Coming after all others in time or order; final.

words.tr:
adj. 极好的；大的；伟大的；
adv. 很好地；
words.ex: This is a great movie!
words.ex_cn: 这是一部极好的电影！
words.en: If you describe someone or something as great, you approve of them or admire them.

words.ex: He greatly improved his English.
words.ex_cn: 他的英语进步了很多。
words.en: To a great extent or degree; very much.

words.ex: The cook wiped off the grease from the pan.
words.ex_cn: 厨师把锅上的油脂擦掉了。
words.en: Grease is a thick, oily substance which is put on the moving parts of cars and other machines in order to make them work smoothly.

words.tr:
adv. 好；对；满意地；
int. （用于表示惊讶，疑虑，接受等）好；
n. 井；
adj. 健康的；
words.ex: She sings well.
words.ex_cn: 她唱得很好。
words.en: In a good or satisfactory manner; in a thorough manner; in a manner that is appropriate or suitable.

words.ex: He is my friend.
words.ex_cn: 他是我的朋友。
words.en: A friend is someone who you know well and like, but who is not related to you.

words.ex: He is a friendly boy who smiles at everyone.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个友好的男孩，对每个人都微笑。
words.en: If someone is friendly, they behave in a pleasant, kind way, and like to be with other people.

words.ex: Their friendship lasted for twenty years.
words.ex_cn: 他们的友谊持续了二十年。
words.en: A friendship is a relationship between two or more friends.

words.tr:
adj. 自己的；
v. 拥有；
words.ex: This is my own book.
words.ex_cn: 这是我的书。
words.en: If you own something, it belongs to you.

words.tr: n. 所有权人；主人；物主；
words.ex: The owner of the house sold it last week.
words.ex_cn: 这所房子的主人上周把它卖了。
words.en: The owner of something is the person to whom it belongs.

words.ex: The paper proves his ownership of the house.
words.ex_cn: 这份文件证明了他对这所房子的物主身份。
words.en: Ownership is the state or fact of owning something.

words.tr:
adv. 向下；
prep. 沿…向下；
adj. 向下的；沮丧的；
words.ex: The ball fell down.
words.ex_cn: 球掉了下去。
words.en: Down is used to indicate movement from a higher to a lower position. It can also refer to a state of being less active or successful.

words.tr:
adv. 向下地；
adj. 向下的；
words.ex: The leaves fell downward slowly.
words.ex_cn: 树叶慢慢向下飘落。
words.en: Moving or leading towards a lower place or level

words.ex: I download music from the internet.
words.ex_cn: 我从互联网下载音乐。
words.en: To download data means to transfer it to your computer or device from another computer or from the internet.

words.ex: The company will downsize next month.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司下个月将裁员。
words.en: If a company or organization downsizes, it reduces the number of people it employs in order to reduce costs or improve efficiency.

words.ex: He went downstairs to get a drink.
words.ex_cn: 他下楼去拿饮料。
words.en: If you go downstairs in a building, you go down a staircase towards the ground floor.

words.tr:
n. 市中心区；商业区；
adv. 在市区；往市区；
words.ex: We went downtown to buy some clothes.
words.ex_cn: 我们去市中心买了一些衣服。
words.en: Downtown refers to the central part or main business and commercial area of a city or town.

words.ex: He wrote a short paragraph about his vacation.
words.ex_cn: 他写了一段关于他假期的短文。
words.en: A paragraph is a section of a piece of writing, usually consisting of several sentences dealing with a single subject. The first sentence of a paragraph typically starts on a new line.

words.ex: My parent helps me with my homework.
words.ex_cn: 我的父母帮我做作业。
words.en: A parent is a mother or father.

words.ex: Good parenting helps children grow happily.
words.ex_cn: 良好的育儿有助于孩子快乐成长。
words.en: Parenting is the activity of bringing up and looking after children.

words.ex: I need the money for the bill.
words.ex_cn: 我需要这笔钱来付账单。
words.en: Money is the coins or bank notes that you use to buy things, or the amount of these that you have.

words.ex: He wants to monetize his YouTube videos.
words.ex_cn: 他想把他的YouTube视频变现。
words.en: To monetize something is to convert it into or establish it as money or legal tender, or to earn revenue from it.

words.tr:
v. 开始；
n. 开始；
words.ex: He starts his day with coffee.
words.ex_cn: 他以喝咖啡开始一天。
words.en: To begin doing something; to cause something to begin or to operate; to set out on a journey.

words.ex: The car needs a new starter to start the engine.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车需要一个新的启动器来发动引擎。
words.en: A starter is a person or thing that starts something, especially a device that initiates the operation of an engine or machine.

words.ex: He will restart the computer after the crash.
words.ex_cn: 他在电脑崩溃后会重新启动它。
words.en: To start something again after it has stopped.

words.tr:
v. 叫；打电话；
n. 打电话；
words.ex: He calls his dog every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上叫他的狗。
words.en: If you call someone, you telephone them. If you call someone a particular name or title, you give them that name or title. If you call a meeting, you arrange for it to take place. If you call for something, you demand that it should happen.

words.tr:
adj. 平静的；镇静的；
v. （使）平静；（使）镇定；
n. 平静；
words.ex: The lake was calm in the morning.
words.ex_cn: 早晨的湖面很平静。
words.en: If someone is calm, they are not excited, anxious, or upset, but are rational and composed.

words.ex: Bread and rice are rich in carbohydrate.
words.ex_cn: 面包和米饭富含碳水化合物。
words.en: A carbohydrate is a substance found in foods such as bread, potatoes, and rice which provides your body with heat and energy and which consists of carbon, hydrogen, and oxygen.

words.tr: n. 硬皮；老茧；胼胝；愈伤组织
words.ex: His hands have a thick callus from working every day.
words.ex_cn: 他的手因为每天工作长了厚厚的茧。
words.en: A callus is an area of thick, hard skin that forms on the body, especially on the hands or feet, as a result of repeated friction or pressure.

words.tr:
v. 交谈；说话；
n. 谈话；
words.ex: They talk every evening after dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他们每天晚饭后都会交谈。
words.en: To speak in order to give information or express ideas or feelings; conversation or discussion.

words.ex: He is a loud talker.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个爱说的人。
words.en: A talker is someone who talks a lot or who is skilled at talking.

words.tr: v. “be”的现在分词；是；在； n. 存在；生物；人；生命；
words.ex: He is being quiet in the library.
words.ex_cn: 他正在图书馆里保持安静。
words.en: The state or quality of having existence.

words.ex: This math problem is very hard.
words.ex_cn: 这道数学难题很难。
words.en: A problem is a situation that is unsatisfactory and causes difficulties for people.

words.ex: We watched three plays last week.
words.ex_cn: 我们上周看了三部戏剧。
words.en: To engage in activity for enjoyment and recreation rather than a serious or practical purpose.

words.tr: n. 运动员；选手；唱机；玩家；
words.ex: The player scored a goal in the final minute.
words.ex_cn: 这名运动员在最后一分钟进了一球。
words.en: A player is someone who takes part in a game or sport, or someone who performs in a theatrical production or musical performance.

words.tr:
v. 答复；回答；
n. 答复；回答；
words.ex: He replied to my message quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他很快回复了我的消息。
words.en: To reply means to say or write something as an answer to something that someone has said or written.

words.ex: He got a new job last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周找到了一份新工作。
words.en: A job is the work that someone does regularly in order to earn money.

words.ex: He jogs every morning to stay healthy.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上慢跑以保持健康。
words.en: To run at a slow, steady pace, especially as a form of exercise.

words.ex: The jogger was wearing bright colors to be more visible at night.
words.ex_cn: 这位慢跑者穿着亮色衣服，以便在夜间更加显眼。
words.en: A jogger is someone who runs at a slow, steady pace as a form of exercise.

words.ex: I will try to run every morning.
words.ex_cn: 我将尝试每天早上跑步。
words.en: To make an attempt or effort to do something.

words.ex: He will try out for the soccer team tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天将参加足球队的选拔。
words.en: A tryout is an opportunity to show that you are suitable for a particular job or activity, especially in sports or acting.

words.tr:
conj. 虽然；尽管；然而；
adv. 虽然；尽管；可是；
words.ex: Though it was raining, he went out.
words.ex_cn: 虽然天下雨了，他还是出去了。
words.en: You use though to introduce a statement in a subordinate clause which contrasts with the statement in the main clause. You often use though to introduce a fact which you regard as less important than the fact in the main clause.

words.tr:
prep. 通过；穿过；
adv. 从头到尾地；彻底；
adj. 直通的；
words.ex: He walked through the door.
words.ex_cn: 他穿过了门。
words.en: Moving in one side and out of the other side of (an opening, channel, or location).

words.ex: They bought a small house near the park.
words.ex_cn: 他们买了一栋靠近公园的小房子。
words.en: A house is a building in which people live, usually the people belonging to one family.

words.tr:
n. 家庭；
adj. 家庭的；
words.ex: This household has three children.
words.ex_cn: 这个家庭有三个孩子。
words.en: A household is all the people in a family or group who live together in a house.

words.ex: The householder cleaned the yard every morning.
words.ex_cn: 这位房主每天早上打扫院子。
words.en: A householder is a person who owns or rents a house; the head of a household.

words.ex: She does housekeeping every Saturday.
words.ex_cn: 她每个星期六做家务。
words.en: Housekeeping refers to the management of duties and chores involved in the running of a household, such as cleaning, cooking, home maintenance, shopping, and bill payment.

words.ex: She is a housewife who takes care of her children.
words.ex_cn: 她是一位照顾孩子的家庭主妇。
words.en: A housewife is a woman who stays at home and looks after her children and her house.

words.ex: He does the housework every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他每个周末都做家务。
words.en: Housework refers to the work done in the house, such as cleaning, cooking, and washing, especially as a regular duty.

words.ex: My mother cooks dinner every evening.
words.ex_cn: 我妈妈每天晚上做晚饭。
words.en: A mother is a female parent of a child. Mothers are women who inhabit or perform the role of bearing some relation to their children, who may or may not be their biological offspring.

words.ex: She gave him a motherly hug when he was sad.
words.ex_cn: 当他难过时，她给了他一个慈母般的拥抱。
words.en: Motherly is used to describe feelings or actions that are like those of a kind and caring mother.

words.ex: He lives in a big city.
words.ex_cn: 他住在一个大城市里。
words.en: A city is a large town where many people live and work.

words.ex: Every citizen must follow the law.
words.ex_cn: 每个公民都必须遵守法律。
words.en: A citizen is a person who is legally recognized as a member of a country or state, either by birth or by naturalization, and who is entitled to its protection and privileges.

words.ex: He applied for citizenship last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年申请了公民身份。
words.en: Citizenship is the status of being a citizen of a particular country.

words.tr: adj. 国内的；公民的；民用的；
words.ex: The country is recovering from a civil war.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家正在从一场内战中恢复。
words.en: relating to ordinary citizens and their concerns, as distinct from military or ecclesiastical matters.

words.ex: Ancient Egypt is one of the oldest civilizations.
words.ex_cn: 古埃及是最早的文明之一。
words.en: A civilization is a human society with its own social organization and culture.

words.tr: v. 使开化；使文明；教化
words.ex: They tried to civilize the wild tribe.
words.ex_cn: 他们试图使这个原始部落文明化。
words.en: To civilize means to bring a place or people to a stage of social, cultural, and moral development considered to be more advanced.

words.ex: I buy apples at the market.
words.ex_cn: 我在市场买苹果。
words.en: To buy means to obtain something by paying money for it.

words.ex: The buyer paid for the car last week.
words.ex_cn: 买方上周支付了车款。
words.en: A buyer is a person who buys something, especially from a shop or another person.

words.ex: The bees made a loud buzz near the flowers.
words.ex_cn: 蜜蜂在花附近发出嗡嗡声。
words.en: To make a low, continuous, humming or sibilant sound, like that made by bees or flies.

words.tr:
adj. 晚的；迟的；已故的；
adv. 晚；迟；
words.ex: The train is late.
words.ex_cn: 火车晚点了。
words.en: After the expected, usual, or proper time.

words.ex: I haven't seen him lately.
words.ex_cn: 我最近没见到他。
words.en: If you say that something has happened lately, you mean that it has happened recently.

words.tr:
n. 后者（the ~）；
adj. 后期的；后面的；
words.ex: I like tea and coffee; I prefer the latter.
words.ex_cn: 我喜欢茶和咖啡；我更喜欢后者。
words.en: The latter is used to refer to the second of two things or people mentioned.

words.ex: He has a talent for playing the piano.
words.ex_cn: 他有弹钢琴的才能。
words.en: If someone has a talent for something, they have a natural ability to do it well.

words.ex: He drinks a latte every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上喝一杯拿铁。
words.en: A latte is a type of coffee made with espresso and steamed milk.

words.ex: He had a good idea to fix the bike.
words.ex_cn: 他想到了一个修自行车的好主意。
words.en: An idea is a thought, plan, or suggestion about what to do, or a belief or opinion.

words.tr:
adj. 理想的；
n. 理想；典范；
words.ex: This is the ideal place to relax.
words.ex_cn: 这是放松的理想地方。
words.en: An ideal is a principle or value that one actively pursues as a goal, often in the context of ethics or morality.

words.ex: Ideally, we should finish the project by Friday.
words.ex_cn: 理想地，我们应该在周五前完成这个项目。
words.en: In an ideal or perfect way; in a way that would be best in an ideal world.

words.tr:
v. 转变；转动；转弯；转身；
n. 转变；轮到的机会；
words.ex: Please turn off the light before you leave.
words.ex_cn: 请在你离开前关掉灯。
words.en: To move or cause to move in a circular direction wholly or partly around an axis or point.

words.ex: He begins his homework after dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他晚饭后开始做作业。
words.en: To start doing something; to take the first step into a process or activity.

words.ex: He is a beginner in piano lessons.
words.ex_cn: 他是钢琴课的初学者。
words.en: A beginner is someone who has just started learning to do something and has not yet mastered it.

words.ex: He begs for food on the street.
words.ex_cn: 他在街上乞讨食物。
words.en: If you beg someone to do something, you ask them very anxiously or eagerly to do it.

words.ex: The beggar sat on the street with a cup.
words.ex_cn: 那个乞丐坐在街上，手里拿着一个杯子。
words.en: A beggar is a person who lives by asking people for money or food.

words.ex: The results according to the data are surprising.
words.ex_cn: 根据数据，结果令人惊讶。
words.en: In a manner corresponding to something stated or understood.

words.ex: The two countries signed an accord to stop the war.
words.ex_cn: 这两个国家签署了一项协议以停止战争。
words.en: An accord is an official agreement or treaty. It can also refer to a state of agreement or harmony.

words.ex: He was late, so he left accordingly.
words.ex_cn: 他迟到了，于是相应地提前出发了。
words.en: In a way that is appropriate to the particular circumstances.

words.tr:
n. 账户；叙述；账目；
v. 占…；说明；
words.ex: I opened a bank account last week.
words.ex_cn: 我上周开了一家银行账户。
words.en: An account is a detailed report or description of an event or situation.

words.ex: The teacher took into account his effort, not just his grade.
words.ex_cn: 老师重视他的努力，而不仅仅是他的分数。
words.en: To consider or remember something when judging a situation.

words.ex: He works as an accountant in a small company.
words.ex_cn: 他在一家小公司当会计师。
words.en: An accountant is a person whose job is to keep, inspect, and analyze financial accounts.

words.ex: The clock shows accurate time.
words.ex_cn: 这个钟显示的时间很精确。
words.en: Correct in all details; exact.

words.ex: The accuracy of the clock is very high.
words.ex_cn: 这个钟的精确性很高。
words.en: The quality or state of being correct or precise.

words.tr: adj. 不精确的；不准确的；有错误的；
words.ex: The clock is inaccurate and shows the wrong time.
words.ex_cn: 这个钟不精确，显示的时间不对。
words.en: If a statement or measurement is inaccurate, it is not correct or not exact.

words.ex: He plays the accordion at the street festival.
words.ex_cn: 他在街头音乐节上演奏手风琴。
words.en: An accordion is a musical instrument that you play by pressing keys or buttons on one side and pulling and pushing a bellows on the other side to force air through reeds, producing notes.

words.ex: He put the book on the table.
words.ex_cn: 他把书放在桌子上。
words.en: If you put something in a particular place or position, you move it into that place or position.

words.tr:
conj. 当…的时候；尽管；然而；
n. 一段时间；一会儿；
words.ex: I read a book while I waited for the bus.
words.ex_cn: 我等公交车的时候读了一本书。
words.en: While is used to introduce a clause in which you mention something that happens at the same time as something else, or to introduce a clause that contrasts with something else that you have mentioned.

words.tr:
adj. 高的；
adv. 在高处；
words.ex: The mountain is very high.
words.ex_cn: 这座山很高。
words.en: If something is high, it is a long way above the ground, above sea level, or above a particular point.

words.ex: The sheep graze on the highland.
words.ex_cn: 羊在高地上吃草。
words.en: Highland refers to an area of high or mountainous land, often characterized by its elevation above sea level and distinct geographical features.

words.tr:
v. 突出；强调；高光；
n. 最突出的部分；
words.ex: The teacher highlighted the key words in the text.
words.ex_cn: 老师把文中的关键词突出了。
words.en: To highlight something means to make it stand out or to emphasize it, often because it is important or interesting.

words.ex: The car drove fast on the highway.
words.ex_cn: 汽车在高速公路上开得很快。
words.en: A highway is a main road, especially one that connects towns or cities.

words.ex: I hear birds singing in the morning.
words.ex_cn: 我听到早晨鸟儿在唱歌。
words.en: To perceive or become aware of (sound) through the ear.

words.tr:
adj. 任何的；
pron. 任何；
adv. 稍微；
words.ex: You can choose any book from the shelf.
words.ex_cn: 你可以从书架上选任何一本书。
words.en: You use any to refer to one or some of a thing or number of things, no matter how much or how many.

words.tr: adv. 不管怎样；无论如何；
words.ex: I don't like the weather, but anyway, we will go for a walk.
words.ex_cn: 我不喜欢这天气，但不管怎样，我们会去散步。
words.en: You use anyway or anyhow to indicate that a statement explains or supports a previous point.

words.ex: Does anybody know the answer?
words.ex_cn: 有人知道答案吗？
words.en: Any person at all; anyone.

words.ex: You can eat anything you like.
words.ex_cn: 你可以吃任何你喜欢的东西。
words.en: Any object, event, fact, etc., that is not specified or known.

words.tr: adv. 无论如何；不管怎样
words.ex: I don't like it, but I'll do it anyhow.
words.ex_cn: 我不喜欢它，但我还是会做。
words.en: in whatever way or manner; regardless of how

words.ex: He felt anxiety before the exam.
words.ex_cn: 他在考试前感到忧虑。
words.en: Anxiety is a feeling of worry, nervousness, or unease about something with an uncertain outcome.

words.tr: adj. 焦虑的；渴望的；担忧的；
words.ex: He feels anxious before every test.
words.ex_cn: 他每次考试前都感到焦虑。
words.en: If you are anxious to do something or anxious that something should happen, you very much want to do it or very much want it to happen.

words.ex: He will probably come to the party.
words.ex_cn: 他很可能来参加派对。
words.en: Used to say that something is likely to be true or likely to happen.

words.ex: It is probable that he will come tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天来的可能性很大。
words.en: If you say that something is probable, you mean that it is likely to be true or likely to happen.

words.ex: The probability of rain tomorrow is high.
words.ex_cn: 明天下雨的概率很高。
words.en: A probability is a measure of how likely it is that some event will occur.

words.tr:
n. 部分；局部；角色；零件；
v. 分离；分开；
words.ex: This part of the book is very easy.
words.ex_cn: 这本书的这一部分非常简单。
words.en: A part is one of the pieces, sections, or elements that together with others constitute a whole.

words.tr: adv. 部分地；在一定程度上；
words.ex: The cake is partly eaten.
words.ex_cn: 这个蛋糕被部分吃掉了。
words.en: To some extent but not completely.

words.ex: He only read the partial report.
words.ex_cn: 他只读了部分报告。
words.en: If you describe something as partial, you mean that it is not complete or whole.

words.ex: The door is partially open.
words.ex_cn: 门部分开着。
words.en: To a limited degree or in a limited manner; not completely.

words.tr:
adv. 正确地；直接地；向右；
adj. 正确的；右边的；
n. 右边；权利；
v. 纠正；
words.ex: He answered the question right.
words.ex_cn: 他正确地回答了问题。
words.en: If something is right, it is correct and agrees with the facts.

words.tr: n. 课；班级；等级；阶级；类别；
words.ex: I have math class at 9 a.m.
words.ex_cn: 我上午九点有数学课。
words.en: A class is a group of pupils or students who are taught together.

words.tr:
adj. 典范的；典型的；
n. 文学经典；名著；优秀的典范；
words.ex: This movie is a classic comedy.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影是一部典范的喜剧。
words.en: A classic is something that is judged to be of the highest quality and outstanding of its kind.

words.ex: He listens to classical music every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上听古典音乐。
words.en: Classical refers to music, literature, or art that is considered to be of the highest quality and of lasting value, especially from the ancient Greek or Roman periods or from the 18th and early 19th centuries.

words.ex: The teacher gave a classification of animals into mammals and birds.
words.ex_cn: 老师将动物分为哺乳动物和鸟类。
words.en: The action or process of classifying something according to shared qualities or characteristics.

words.ex: The teacher will classify the students by age.
words.ex_cn: 老师将按年龄对学生进行分类。
words.en: To classify things means to divide them into groups or types so that things with similar characteristics are in the same group.

words.ex: My classmate helped me with my homework.
words.ex_cn: 我的同班同学帮我做了作业。
words.en: A classmate is someone who is in the same class as you at school or college.

words.ex: The students are sitting in the classroom.
words.ex_cn: 学生们正坐在教室里。
words.en: A room in a school where lessons take place.

words.tr:
adv. 仍然；还是；
adj. 静止的；
words.ex: He is still waiting for the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他仍然在等公交车。
words.en: If a situation that used to exist still exists, it has continued and exists now.

words.tr:
n. 经验；阅历；
v. 经历；体验；
words.ex: He has a lot of experience in teaching English.
words.ex_cn: 他有丰富的英语教学经验。
words.en: Experience is knowledge or skill in a particular job or activity that you have gained because you have done that job or activity for a long time.

words.ex: We will meet at the park tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我们明天将在公园见面。
words.en: To come into the presence of someone by chance or arrangement.

words.tr: n. 会议；会面； v. 遇见；见面；“meet”的现在分词；
words.ex: The meeting starts at 9 a.m.
words.ex_cn: 会议上午九点开始。
words.en: A meeting is an event in which a group of people come together to discuss things or make decisions.

words.tr:
n. 水；
v. 给…浇水；给（某地）供水；
words.ex: She drinks water every morning.
words.ex_cn: 她每天早上喝水。
words.en: Water is a clear thin liquid that has no colour or taste when it is pure. It falls from clouds as rain and enters rivers and seas. All animals and plants need water in order to live.

words.ex: This jacket is waterproof.
words.ex_cn: 这件夹克是防水的。
words.en: Something that is waterproof does not let water pass through it.

words.tr:
n. 水彩画
adj. 水彩的
words.ex: He paints with watercolor on paper.
words.ex_cn: 他用水彩在纸上绘画。
words.en: A watercolor is a painting done with watercolors, or the paint used in such paintings.

words.ex: The waterfall makes a loud sound.
words.ex_cn: 瀑布发出很大的声音。
words.en: A waterfall is a place where water flows over the edge of a steep, high cliff in hills or mountains, and falls into a pool below.

words.ex: He eats a watermelon every summer.
words.ex_cn: 他每年夏天都吃西瓜。
words.en: A watermelon is a large, round fruit with green skin, pink flesh, and black seeds.

words.ex: The boat travels on the waterway.
words.ex_cn: 船在水道上行驶。
words.en: A waterway is a river, canal, or other route for travel by water.

words.ex: He answered all the questions correctly.
words.ex_cn: 他全部答对了这些问题。
words.en: Questions are sentences or phrases that ask for information, opinions, or instructions.

words.tr: adj. 可疑的；有问题的；不可靠的；
words.ex: The deal seemed questionable.
words.ex_cn: 这笔交易看起来可疑。
words.en: If you say that something is questionable, you mean that it is not obviously true or real, and therefore possibly not valid or reliable.

words.ex: It is important to eat healthy food.
words.ex_cn: 吃健康的食物很重要。
words.en: Something that is important is very significant, is highly valued, or is necessary.

words.ex: The importance of homework is clear.
words.ex_cn: 作业的重要性是显而易见的。
words.en: The quality or state of being important; significance.

words.ex: The small mistake was unimportant.
words.ex_cn: 这个小错误不重要。
words.en: If you describe something or someone as unimportant, you mean that they do not have much influence, effect, or value, and are therefore not worth serious consideration.

words.tr:
n. 进口；重要性；
v. 进口；
words.ex: The country increased its import of oil last year.
words.ex_cn: 去年这个国家增加了石油的进口。
words.en: To bring in (goods or services) from a foreign country for sale or use.

words.ex: He drives a red car to work.
words.ex_cn: 他开车去上班。
words.en: A car is a motor vehicle with four wheels, usually propelled by an internal combustion engine.

words.ex: He ate a caramel candy after dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他晚饭后吃了一颗焦糖糖果。
words.en: Caramel is a substance made by heating sugar until it changes color, used to give flavor and a brown color to food.

words.ex: Carbon is an element in all living things.
words.ex_cn: 碳是所有生物体中的一种元素。
words.en: Carbon is a chemical element with symbol C and atomic number 6. It is nonmetallic and tetravalent—making four electrons available to form covalent chemical bonds.

words.ex: I used my card to pay for the groceries.
words.ex_cn: 我用我的银行卡支付了杂货费用。
words.en: A card is a piece of stiff paper or thin cardboard on which something is written or printed, or a small rectangular piece of plastic containing personal data in a machine-readable form.

words.ex: He made a box from cardboard.
words.ex_cn: 他用纸板做了一个盒子。
words.en: Cardboard is a stiff, heavy paper material that is used for making boxes and other packaging.

words.ex: The carmaker released a new electric model.
words.ex_cn: 这家汽车制造商发布了一款新的电动车。
words.en: A carmaker is a company that manufactures cars.

words.ex: We went to the carnival last weekend.
words.ex_cn: 我们上周末去了嘉年华。
words.en: A carnival is a public festival, typically one held annually in a particular place, involving processions, music, and dancing.

words.ex: The carpenter made a wooden table.
words.ex_cn: 木匠做了一张木桌子。
words.en: A carpenter is a person whose job is making and repairing wooden objects and structures.

words.ex: He walks on the carpet every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上都走在地毯上。
words.en: A carpet is a thick covering of soft material which is laid over a floor or a staircase.

words.ex: The king rode in a wooden carriage drawn by four horses.
words.ex_cn: 国王乘坐一辆由四匹马拉的木制四轮马车。
words.en: A carriage is a vehicle with four wheels that is pulled by horses and is used for carrying people.

words.ex: He eats a carrot every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天吃一根胡萝卜。
words.en: A carrot is a long, thin, orange-colored vegetable that grows underground.

words.ex: He carries a bag to school every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天带一个包去学校。
words.en: To carry something means to move it while supporting it, especially in your hands or arms.

words.ex: He is a carrier of the flu virus.
words.ex_cn: 他是流感病毒的携带者。
words.en: A carrier is a person or thing that carries, holds, or conveys something.

words.ex: The farmer drove his cart full of apples to the market.
words.ex_cn: 农夫驾着装满苹果的运货马车去市场。
words.en: A cart is a vehicle with two or four wheels that is pulled by a horse or a person and is used for carrying goods.

words.ex: My brother watches cartoon every evening.
words.ex_cn: 我弟弟每天晚上看卡通片。
words.en: A cartoon is a humorous drawing or series of drawings in a newspaper or magazine, or a film made using animation techniques.

words.ex: He carved the meat with a sharp knife.
words.ex_cn: 他用一把锋利的刀切开了肉。
words.en: To carve means to cut into a hard material in order to produce an object, design, or inscription.

words.ex: The carver made a wooden bird with fine details.
words.ex_cn: 这位雕刻家雕刻了一只细节精致的木鸟。
words.en: A carver is someone who carves objects from materials such as wood or stone, or a knife used for carving meat.

words.ex: The young boy plays soccer every afternoon.
words.ex_cn: 这个年轻的孩子每天下午都踢足球。
words.en: Someone who is young has not lived for very long or is not yet mature.

words.ex: The youngster rode his bike to school every day.
words.ex_cn: 这个年轻人每天骑自行车去上学。
words.en: A youngster is a young person, especially a child or teenager.

words.tr:
v. 支付；付出代价；
n. 工资；
words.ex: He will pay for the food tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天会支付饭钱。
words.en: If you pay for something which you buy or for a service which you use, you give money to the person who is selling it or providing it.

words.ex: He made the payment online.
words.ex_cn: 他在线支付了。
words.en: A payment is an amount of money that is paid to someone, or the act of paying this money.

words.ex: You need to prepay for the service before using it.
words.ex_cn: 在使用服务之前，你需要预先付款。
words.en: To pay for something before it is received or before it is due.

words.ex: The payer sent the money on time.
words.ex_cn: 付款人按时汇了钱。
words.en: A payer is a person or organization that makes a payment or is responsible for making payments.

words.tr: n. 付薪水的支票；薪水
words.ex: He gets his paycheck every Friday.
words.ex_cn: 他每周五领工资。
words.en: A paycheck is a check that an employee receives from their employer as payment for their work.

words.tr:
v. 建筑；建造；逐步加强；
n. 体格；体形；
words.ex: They build a house near the lake.
words.ex_cn: 他们在湖边建了一所房子。
words.en: To construct something by putting parts or material together.

words.ex: They will rebuild the house after the storm.
words.ex_cn: 他们将在风暴后重建这座房子。
words.en: To rebuild something means to build it again after it has been damaged or destroyed.

words.tr: n. 建筑物；楼房； v. 建筑；“build”的现在分词；
words.ex: The tall building has 20 floors.
words.ex_cn: 这栋高楼有20层。
words.en: A building is a structure that has a roof and walls and stands more or less permanently in one place.

words.ex: He is a big boy now.
words.ex_cn: 他现在是个大男孩了。
words.en: Of considerable size or extent; larger than other items of its kind.

words.tr:
n. 努力争取；出价；投标；
v. 出价；投标；
words.ex: His bid for the championship inspired everyone.
words.ex_cn: 他为冠军所做的努力鼓舞了所有人。
words.en: To bid means to offer a particular amount of money for something that is being sold, especially at an auction, or to offer to do work or provide services for a particular price.

words.ex: He rides his bike to school every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天骑自行车去学校。
words.en: A bike is a vehicle with two wheels which you ride by sitting on it and pushing two pedals with your feet. You steer it by turning a bar that is connected to the front wheel.

words.ex: I paid the electric bill yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 我昨天付了电费账单。
words.en: A bill is a statement of money owed for goods or services, a proposed law presented to a legislature for approval, a piece of paper money, or the beak of a bird.

words.ex: The ad is on a big billboard near the road.
words.ex_cn: 广告牌在路边的大广告牌上。
words.en: A billboard is a large outdoor board for displaying advertisements.

words.ex: There are a billion stars in the sky.
words.ex_cn: 天空中有十亿颗星星。
words.en: A billion is a thousand million, or 1,000,000,000.

words.tr:
n. 兴趣；利息；利益；
v. 使产生兴趣；
words.ex: He has a strong interest in painting.
words.ex_cn: 他对绘画有浓厚的兴趣。
words.en: If you have an interest in something, you want to learn or hear more about it.

words.tr:
adj. 下一个的；
adv. 随后；
pron. 下一个；
words.ex: This is the next bus to the city.
words.ex_cn: 这是下一班去城市的公交车。
words.en: Coming immediately after the present one in order, sequence, or time.

words.ex: I will see you next week.
words.ex_cn: 我下周见你。
words.en: A week is a period of seven days.

words.tr:
adj. 每周的；
adv. 每周；
words.ex: He gets paid weekly.
words.ex_cn: 他每周领工资。
words.en: Happening or done once a week or every week; a newspaper or magazine that is published once a week.

words.tr: n. 工作日（周一至周五中的任何一天）
words.ex: He goes to work every weekday.
words.ex_cn: 他每个工作日都去上班。
words.en: A weekday is any of the days from Monday to Friday, when most people go to work or school.

words.ex: I will visit you this weekend.
words.ex_cn: 我这周末去看你。
words.en: The weekend is Saturday and Sunday, the two days in the week when many people do not work.

words.tr: n. 周日夜晚（指周末休息日以外的每个夜晚）
words.ex: He eats dinner early on weeknights.
words.ex_cn: 他在工作日晚上很早吃晚饭。
words.en: A weeknight is any evening of the week except Friday, Saturday, or Sunday.

words.ex: There are a lot of books on the shelf.
words.ex_cn: 书架上有许多书。
words.en: A lot refers to a large number or amount of something. It can also mean a piece of land or someone's fate or destiny.

words.tr:
n. 文本；课文；
v. 发短信；
words.ex: He read the text carefully.
words.ex_cn: 他仔细阅读了文本。
words.en: Text refers to any written material, especially the main body of a book or other piece of writing, as distinct from illustrations, notes, or appendices.

words.ex: He bought a new textbook for math class.
words.ex_cn: 他为数学课买了一本新教科书。
words.en: A textbook is a book containing a comprehensive compilation of content in a branch of study with the intention of explaining it. Textbooks are produced to meet the needs of educators, usually at educational institutions.

words.tr:
v. 经营；跑步；
n. 运转；跑；
words.ex: He runs a small coffee shop.
words.ex_cn: 他经营一家小咖啡馆。
words.en: To move quickly on foot so that both feet leave the ground during each stride.

words.ex: The runner won the race quickly.
words.ex_cn: 这位跑步者很快赢得了比赛。
words.en: A runner is a person who runs, especially in a race or as a sport.

words.ex: He works for a small company.
words.ex_cn: 他在一家小公司工作。
words.en: A company is a business organization that makes money by producing or selling goods or services.

words.ex: He walked home with his companion.
words.ex_cn: 他和同伴一起走回家。
words.en: A companion is someone who you spend time with or who you are travelling with.

words.tr:
v. 观看；观察；小心；
n. 手表；监视；注意；
words.ex: I watch TV every evening.
words.ex_cn: 我每天晚上看电视。
words.en: To look at or observe attentively over a period of time.

words.tr: n. 监视器；看守人；岗哨
words.ex: The watcher recorded the activity through the camera.
words.ex_cn: 监视器通过摄像头记录了活动。
words.en: A watcher is someone who watches or observes something or someone, often to ensure that nothing bad happens.

words.tr:
v. 热爱；爱；
n. 爱；爱情；爱好的事物；
words.ex: I love playing football with my friends.
words.ex_cn: 我热爱和朋友们一起踢足球。
words.en: Love is a very strong feeling of affection towards someone that you are romantically or sexually attracted to.

words.ex: He gave a rose to his lover on Valentine's Day.
words.ex_cn: 他在情人节给情人送了一朵玫瑰。
words.en: A lover is someone who is in a romantic or sexual relationship with another person, or someone who enjoys a particular thing or activity very much.

words.ex: The little girl has a lovely smile.
words.ex_cn: 这个小女孩有一个可爱的笑容。
words.en: If you describe someone or something as lovely, you mean that they are very beautiful and therefore pleasing to look at or be with.

words.ex: The animal is sleeping in the forest.
words.ex_cn: 这只动物正在森林里睡觉。
words.en: An animal is a living creature such as a dog, lion, or rabbit, rather than a plant, insect, bird, or fish.

words.ex: The ancient Egyptians built the pyramids.
words.ex_cn: 古埃及人建造了金字塔。
words.en: Belonging to the very distant past and no longer in existence.

words.ex: My ancestor came from China a hundred years ago.
words.ex_cn: 我的祖先一百年前来自中国。
words.en: An ancestor is a person from whom one is descended, typically more remote than a grandparent.

words.ex: His anger grew when he heard the news.
words.ex_cn: 当他听到这个消息时，他的愤怒增加了。
words.en: A strong feeling of annoyance, displeasure, or hostility.

words.ex: He became angry when his phone broke.
words.ex_cn: 当他手机坏了时，他生气了。
words.en: Feeling or showing strong annoyance, displeasure, or hostility; full of anger.

words.ex: The child drew a picture of an angel with wings.
words.ex_cn: 孩子画了一幅有翅膀的天使的画。
words.en: An angel is a spiritual being believed to act as a messenger or servant of God, conventionally represented in human form with wings and a long robe.

words.ex: He told an anecdote about his childhood.
words.ex_cn: 他讲了一个关于他童年的趣事。
words.en: An anecdote is a short, amusing or interesting story about a real incident or person.

words.ex: My mother teaches me math every evening.
words.ex_cn: 我妈妈每天晚上教我数学。
words.en: To impart knowledge or skill to someone through instruction or example.

words.ex: The teacher helps students with math.
words.ex_cn: 老师帮助学生学习数学。
words.en: A teacher is a person whose job is to teach in a school or college.

words.ex: The speaker told a funny story.
words.ex_cn: 说话者讲了一个有趣的故事。
words.en: A speaker is someone who speaks, especially someone who gives a speech or makes a presentation.

words.ex: He spends money on books.
words.ex_cn: 他花钱买书。
words.en: To spend means to use money to buy or pay for something, or to use time or energy in a particular way.

words.tr:
v. 设置；使固定；放置；
n. 一组；一套；
adj. 固定的；位于…的；安排好的；
words.ex: He set the alarm for 6 a.m.
words.ex_cn: 他把闹钟设在早上六点。
words.en: To put something in a specified place or position; to adjust or arrange something; a group of things that belong together or are used together; fixed or established.

words.tr: v. 设置；放；“set”的现在分词； n. 环境；背景；
words.ex: He is setting the alarm for 6 a.m.
words.ex_cn: 他正在把闹钟设置为早上6点。
words.en: The context and environment in which something is set or takes place.

words.ex: A kind person helped me find my way.
words.ex_cn: 一位善良的人帮我找到了路。
words.en: A human being regarded as an individual.

words.ex: This is my personal notebook.
words.ex_cn: 这是我的个人笔记本。
words.en: Relating to or belonging to a particular person rather than to a group or an organization.

words.tr: adv. 就本人而言；亲自地；
words.ex: Personally, I like tea more than coffee.
words.ex_cn: 就本人而言，我更喜欢茶而不是咖啡。
words.en: If you do something personally, you do it yourself rather than letting someone else do it. You can also use personally to show that you are talking about your own opinion or experience.

words.tr: adj. 人与人之间的；人际关系的；
words.ex: Good interpersonal skills help people work together.
words.ex_cn: 良好的人际交往能力有助于人们合作。
words.en: relating to relationships or communication between people

words.tr: v. 使个人化；使（某事物）针对个人；个性化
words.ex: She can personalize her phone with a new wallpaper.
words.ex_cn: 她可以用新的壁纸来个性化她的手机。
words.en: To make something suitable for the needs of a particular person, often by changing or adding to it.

words.ex: His personality is very friendly and outgoing.
words.ex_cn: 他的个性非常友好和外向。
words.en: The combination of characteristics or qualities that form an individual's distinctive character.

words.tr: n. 全体人员；人事部；职员；
words.ex: The company hired new personnel last month.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司上个月雇佣了新员工。
words.en: The people who are employed in a company or organization.

words.ex: He loves his country and wants to serve it.
words.ex_cn: 他热爱自己的国家，想要为它服务。
words.en: A country is a region identified as a distinct entity in political geography.

words.ex: He grew up in the countryside.
words.ex_cn: 他是在农村长大的。
words.en: The countryside refers to the land and scenery of a rural area, often characterized by farms, fields, and small villages, away from urban centers.

words.ex: He lives in a small county in the countryside.
words.ex_cn: 他住在乡村的一个小郡里。
words.en: A county is a region of a country used for administrative or other purposes in certain modern nations.

words.ex: I saw a couple of birds flying in the sky.
words.ex_cn: 我看见几只鸟在天上飞。
words.en: A couple is two people who are married, living together, or having a sexual relationship. It can also refer to a small number of things or people.

words.ex: The room has a bed and a window.
words.ex_cn: 这个房间有一张床和一扇窗户。
words.en: A room is a part of the inside of a building that is separated from other parts by walls, floor, and ceiling.

words.ex: My roommate likes to listen to music at night.
words.ex_cn: 我的室友喜欢晚上听音乐。
words.en: A roommate is a person with whom one shares a room or rooms, especially in a college or university dormitory or a shared apartment.

words.tr:
n. 姓名；名称；
v. 说出…的名字；命名；
words.ex: His name is Tom.
words.ex_cn: 他的名字是汤姆。
words.en: The word or words that a person, thing, or place is known by.

words.ex: He has three hobbies, namely reading, swimming, and painting.
words.ex_cn: 他有三个爱好，即阅读、游泳和绘画。
